caption: The drawing depicts a decorative wrought iron fence or railing, set upon a rectangular base shaded in light gray tones. The fence consists of four prominent vertical pillars, one at each corner, with detailed finials on top of each. The central section of the fence features five twisted vertical bars between the pillars, with each bar twisted in a spiral pattern. The top of the fence showcases an ornate arched element adorned with symmetrical floral and vine motifs and scrollwork, including leaves and flowers. On both the left and right sides connected to the corner pillars, additional vertical bars are present, embellished with intricate vine and leaf patterns that extend outward, creating a three-dimensional effect. The entire composition is rendered in shades of gray and beige, indicating a monochromatic palette; the objects are clearly defined against a plain, light beige background. The drawing style uses fine lines and shading to give volume and detail to the metalwork.
title: Cast Iron Gate and Fence
